says: oxlint-plugins/README.md says the Effect checker's effectFnOpportunity check remains off, and tsconfig.base.json turns it on as an error for all of next/.
proof: On origin/main at e4404464d91114e66c326272e7fba9c6313db19f, oxlint-plugins/README.md line 618 reads `effectFnOpportunity` remains off. Its earlier 11 false alarms among 17 findings. tsconfig.base.json line 80 reads "effectFnOpportunity": "error", inside the block at line 73 whose include is ["next/**/*.ts", "next/**/*.tsx"].
cost: A reader who trusts the README thinks the check is off and keeps our own effect-functions rule for a gap that is already covered in part, and may weigh the swap against a wrong picture of what blocks.
